messages:
Kara (Design): Dropping a new concept for Trace Viewer: a heatmap row that surfaces 'error density' + inline affordances for exporting small snippets. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/heatmap-trace :mag_right: please skim.
Ethan - Eng: Heatmap looks neat. Two engineering notes: 1) generating the heatmap tiles is cheap server-side but we should cache per-trace-view to avoid repeated renders, 2) exported snippet should be a JSON with context window (span +/- N siblings) not the whole trace.
Priya - PM: Product ask: default export behavior should be "snippet" (fast), with an explicit "full export" that warns about size and compliance. We need redaction profiles for PCI/PHI orgs: redacted, masked, or none. How do we show that in the UI?
Sophie (A11y): Accessibility points: heatmap cells must have accessible names (e.g., "3 errors in span 1, high severity"). For colorblind users, add a pattern overlay or alternative text toggle. Live-region should announce when export completes.
Kara (Design): UX proposal: each heatmap cell exposes a compact menu: Copy span, Copy permalink, Export snippet, Preview snippet. Preview opens a lightweight drawer (no full JSON dump) with top 5 spans and size estimate. For redaction, show a small badge on the export button: "Redaction: masked".
Ethan - Eng: Backend: implement /api/v1/traces/:id/preview?span=123&context=2 that returns a small NDJSON chunk and an X-Estimated-Bytes header. For permalinks: hosted orgs get stable hashed links; Private/Dedicated get ephemeral signed tokens with ttl=7200s. We'll add an org flag to disable full exports.
Priya - PM: Microcopy for the preview CTA: "Preview snippet (shows ~5 spans)". For full export confirm modal text: "Full trace exports can be large. Estimated size: ~{size}. This action may be disabled by your org's export policy." Include a small cost hint for egress.
Sophie (A11y): For preview drawer use role=dialog and trap focus. Use aria-live polite for progress: "Preview generating" -> "Preview ready". For heatmap color choices prefer a colorblind-safe palette (ColorBrewer RdYlBu but tested). Also include a text-only toggle: "Show counts" that renders numbers instead of color.
Kara (Design): Keyboard interactions: when a row is focused: H = toggle heatmap text overlay, P = preview snippet, E = export menu, K = copy permalink. We'll scope single-letter shortcuts only when trace container has focus and show a tooltip hint in the row.
Ethan - Eng: Note about copy/permalink: `navigator.clipboard.writeText` for modern browsers; fallback on mobile to show a selectable input. For huge previews we stream and show progress; allow cancel. We'll emit SSE events for progress (preview-ready, export-complete).
Priya - PM: Acceptance criteria: 1) heatmap with accessible names + text-only overlay 2) preview snippet API + client drawer with size estimate + cancelable streaming 3) export menu with snippet/full and redaction profile selection + org gating 4) permalink behavior per org type + clear toast copy messages 5) keyboard shortcuts documented + conflict matrix 6) accessibility checklist attached to ticket.
ux-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/trace-heatmap-preview-v1.png
Kara (Design): I'll push an updated Figma with pattern overlays for colorblind mode, the preview drawer mock, microcopy for redaction badges, and the keyboard hint strip.
Ethan - Eng: Scheduling a quick dev handoff Thu 9am. I'll add backend tasks: preview endpoint, estimated-size header, SSE progress, share-token for private orgs, and org flag for export gating. Also adding cache headers for heatmap tiles.
Sophie (A11y): I'll draft the a11y test checklist: 1) heatmap cell names + focus 2) dialog focus trapping 3) live-region messages not noisy 4) keyboard shortcut scoping 5) screenreader friendly preview content.
Priya - PM: Thanks team. Kara, tag the product ticket when mocks are ready and include the a11y checklist in the PR. We'll aim to get snippet + preview shipped first, full export gated by policy follow-up.
